plugin.name: Far Cry Widescreen Fix
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Constrain HUD placement to Auto, 16:9, 21:9 or a custom ratio.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected gameplay field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Applies to the next camera update.
SMAA.description: Apply subpixel morphological antialiasing. Requires native MSAA to be disabled.
ConsoleGamma.description: Apply the existing higher-contrast console gamma curve.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language for Plugins and other plugins. Automatic falls back to English when the game language cannot be identified. Edit in the hub or CFG, then reopen Plugins.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original keeps the source aspect with black bars; Fill crops to the movie area; Stretch fills it without preserving aspect. Changes apply live.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the startup legal and publisher/engine logo movies. Story movies and the normal options/profile checks remain available.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, framed window or monitor-sized borderless. Changes use the native display reset at the next foreground frame. Alt+Enter switches fullscreen and the last window mode.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game client area. Releases on focus loss, window dragging, system menus or when disabled. Independent of mouse input.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
